task.name: Release Rollback Readiness Enforcement
task.description: Review production release candidates before promotion and surface only candidates that lack repository-verifiable rollback readiness bound to the exact candidate revision and production environment.
task.intent: Give operators repository-verifiable, revision-specific rollback-readiness evidence before production promotion without claiming authority to approve or block that promotion, independently of whether release notes are complete.
activationConditions: A production release candidate enters the repository's release approval window with an immutable candidate revision and named production environment.

Authoritative repository evidence cannot verify every required rollback-readiness control for that candidate: an executable rollback procedure, accountable owner, revision and environment binding, and a qualifying rehearsal or restoration result within the configured freshness window.
requiredEffects: Each novel readiness finding identifies the release candidate, failed rollback-readiness control, evidence requirement, evidence cutoff, and repository links supporting the determination.
Each surfaced blocker provides repository-linked evidence that release operators can use in their existing approval control; the review workflow does not approve, block, or perform promotion.
noopConditions: Every covered production release candidate has complete, fresh rollback-readiness evidence bound to its exact revision and environment before the approval cutoff.
Every supported readiness gap for the candidate is already tracked, or an authorized and unexpired exception explicitly accepts it.
successConditions: A blocked release candidate obtains accepted evidence for every supported rollback-readiness control before production promotion, or is withdrawn.
Ready candidates and candidates with valid authorized exceptions create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A rollback rehearsal against a staging environment may qualify only when repository policy explicitly establishes production equivalence and the evidence remains within the configured freshness window.
Some irreversible migrations require an approved forward-recovery procedure rather than restoration; whether that procedure satisfies rollback readiness is repository-policy dependent.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported production release candidates assigned to the run that attain complete accepted rollback-readiness evidence before promotion or are withdrawn before exposing production.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated production release candidates it evaluates for promotion, each bound to one immutable candidate revision and production environment.
acceptedEvidence: Repository-controlled release approval or deployment evidence recorded before promotion that binds the candidate revision and production environment to an executable rollback or approved forward-recovery procedure, accountable owner, and qualifying fresh rehearsal or restoration result.
Repository release or deployment evidence showing a non-ready candidate was withdrawn before production promotion.
A repository-linked, authorized, unexpired exception that names the exact candidate revision, production environment, unmet control, approver, and expiration.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.
A repository explicitly linked by the release candidate as the authoritative home of its deployment and rollback evidence.

metric.name: rollback-ready-or-safely-withdrawn-release-candidates
metric.formula: supported release candidates with complete accepted rollback-readiness evidence before promotion or withdrawal before production / supported production release candidates assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: At the earliest of production promotion, candidate withdrawal, or 14 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported production release candidate was assigned and none obtained complete accepted rollback-readiness evidence before promotion or was withdrawn before production by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned candidate set, immutable revision or environment binding, promotion timing, or required repository-controlled rollback evidence cannot be read.

rows.finding-summary: Candidate v2.0.0 at revision abc123 for production lacks a fresh restoration result before the approval cutoff.

rows.outcome-summary: Release operators accepted revision- and environment-bound procedure, owner, and fresh restoration evidence before promotion.
